aboutPage.title: Building Gostivar's Residential Future with Direct Accountability
aboutPage.subtitle: SHERIAG is an independent construction and real-estate development company in Gostivar, North Macedonia. We design, fund, and build exclusively our own residential projects.
aboutPage.storyTitle: Why We Only Build Our Own Projects
aboutPage.storyP1: In the construction industry, many buildings are split between an investor who wants to minimize cost and an outside contractor who simply executes a contract. At SHERIAG, we chose a different path from the beginning.
aboutPage.storyP2: SHERIAG develops and builds ONLY its own residential complexes. We never do third-party contract work. That means every structural column, every acoustic wall, every parking ramp, and every neighborhood park carries our name permanently.
aboutPage.storyP3: Having delivered four complete residential buildings in Gostivar and now constructing our fifth flagship complex, we serve local families as well as diaspora buyers seeking a dependable, modern home in their hometown.

quality.title: Uncompromising Structural Quality
quality.text: Certified materials, rigorous seismic engineering, and modern thermal and acoustic insulation on every floor.

community.title: Complete Living Environments
community.text: We believe a residential building is incomplete without safe parking, green courtyards, and space for families to gather.

transparency.title: Direct & Honest Relationships
transparency.text: Clear contracts, milestone updates, and direct communication with the developer from first inquiry to key handover.

privacyPage.section1Body: When you submit our Quote Request or Contact forms, we collect your name, phone number, email address, preferred contact method, and your apartment preferences.
privacyPage.section2Body: We use your information exclusively to respond to your inquiry, provide apartment availability and pricing details, and schedule office or site visits in Gostivar. We never sell or rent your data to third parties.
